body:
Done in 6b7857624. Added a build-path fail-closed regression test `fails closed when upstream input files are missing or malformed` in `post-attempt-structured-review-posture.test.js`.

It exercises the real `buildPostAttemptStructuredReviewPosture` (which loads upstream from files) in two ways:
1. **Missing** — a temp root with no upstream files: `upstream.schema`/`readModelValidator`/`rightsGateValidator` are all `null`.
2. **Malformed** — invalid-JSON schema plus a non-passing read-model validator and an issue-mismatched rights gate validator.

Both assert `validator_status === 'fail'` and that errors include `upstream_schema_or_validators_not_passing` and `check_failed:upstream_schema_and_validators_passing` (the exact current fail-closed diagnostics), with no throw.

It also asserts the #1433 boundary holds on the fail-closed path: `authoritative_score_allowed_count` and `point_judgement_allowed_count` stay `0` and no case reports `released_deterministic` scoring — no scoring-authority / released-deterministic claim is introduced.

Focused posture suite + the sibling chain suites (#1441 schema, #1431 read-model, #1432 rights-gate) pass: 47 tests.
